level_viewer_can: 👁 Viewer can see the chats, version, service health, errors and queues. Nothing can be changed.
level_support_can: 🧰 Support can also re-check a chat with Telegram, open an error's details, read the audit log and verify its seals.
level_manager_can: 🛡 Manager can also suspend, resume or leave a chat, download a chat's backup, post a message in a chat, export the log as CSV, seal the log, pause or resume timed work, run the sweeps and release stuck locks.
denied: 🚫 Your access ({level}) does not allow this.
off_toast: ⏸ This is turned off for now by the Aegis team.
chat_paused_panel: ⏸ The Aegis team has suspended Aegis in this chat. Its settings are kept and come back when it is resumed.
new_chats_closed: 🚪 Aegis is not taking new chats right now, so it is leaving. Please try again later.
chats_hint: Press a number for the chat's details. ⚠️ bot not admin · 🚪 bot left · ⏸ suspended
search_prompt: 🔎 Send a chat's id (-100…), its @username or a part of its title.
chat_data: ⚙️ Settings changed: {settings} · active punishments: {punishments} · lockdowns: {lockdown} · logged events: {events}
refresh_gone: 🚪 Telegram says Aegis is no longer in this chat; it is marked as left.
suspend_q: ⏸ Suspend Aegis in {title}? While suspended, Aegis ignores everything in this chat: messages, commands, buttons, join requests and posts; its panel is closed to the chat's admins. Nothing is deleted and the settings stay. Timed items that are already due (scheduled posts, ends of locks) still run, so nothing stays locked. Membership changes are still recorded.
suspended: ⏸ Aegis is suspended in this chat.
resumed: ▶️ Aegis works in this chat again.
suspend_full: ⚠️ Too many chats are suspended already (limit reached).
leave_q: 🚪 Leave {title}? Aegis leaves the chat now. Its settings stay in the database; if an admin adds Aegis again, they come back.
left_failed: ⚠️ Telegram did not confirm leaving; the chat is marked as left anyway.
backup_chat_caption: 💾 Configuration backup of {title} (settings, lists, locks, security). The chat's admins can restore it from the chat's panel.
file_failed: ⚠️ The file could not be sent.
say_prompt: ✉️ Send the text to post in {title}. It is posted as a message from the Aegis team (text only).
say_text_only: ✉️ Only text can be sent this way. Send a text, or cancel.
say_gone: 🚪 Aegis is no longer in that chat.
say_failed: ⚠️ Telegram refused the message (no right to post there?).
staff_levels: People here open /staff and see only what their level allows. The owner panel, broadcasts and the global switch stay yours alone.
staff_prompt: ➕ Send the person's numeric id, their @username (if they have opened Aegis) or forward a message from them. They start as 👁 Viewer.
staff_bad: ⚠️ No person found. Send a numeric id, an @username of someone who opened Aegis, or a forwarded message.
staff_hidden: ⚠️ That person hides their account in forwards. Send their numeric id instead.
staff_added: ✅ Added as 👁 Viewer and told in private. Choose a level below.
staff_added_unstarted: ✅ Added as 👁 Viewer. They have not opened Aegis yet, so they were not told; /staff works once they do.
staff_gone: ℹ️ Not in the team anymore.
staff_remove_q: 🗑 Remove {name} from the bot team? Their access ends at once.
member_notice: 👮 You are now in the Aegis team with the level {level}. Open your panel with /staff.
member_removed_notice: ℹ️ You are no longer in the Aegis team.
log_note: Append-only: Aegis never edits or deletes these entries, and the database refuses to (triggers). Seals prove nothing was changed afterwards.
seals_explain: Every 15 minutes the new log entries are sealed: a SHA-256 hash over them and the seal before. If an entry is changed or deleted later, its seal no longer matches. With a global log channel set, every seal's hash is also posted there, outside the database.
seals_guard_on: 🛡 Database guard: on (UPDATE and DELETE are refused).
seals_guard_off: ⚠️ Database guard: off — the data migration has not run yet.
seals_channel: 📮 Seals are copied to the log channel {id}.
seals_no_channel: 📮 No global log channel: seals stay in the database only (System settings).
verify_ok: ✅ Every entry matches its seal and the chain is unbroken.
why_chain: the chain is broken (a seal was changed or removed)
why_gap: a range of entries is missing between seals
verify_tail: Entries written after the last seal are checked once they are sealed.
set_g_new_chats_note: Off: Aegis leaves any group or channel it is newly added to (after a short notice), unless you or someone in the team added it.
set_g_fun_note: Off: fun commands, games and their buttons stop in every chat (each chat's own choices are kept).
set_g_media_note: Off: stickers, GIFs, image tools, QR and OCR stop for everyone. The security checks of QR codes and PDFs keep working.
set_g_err_notify_note: Off: errors are still recorded (Errors), you just don't get a private notice.
set_g_jobs_note: Off: broadcasts stop advancing and the once-a-minute sweeps stop (captcha expiry, ends of locks, scheduled posts, contests, polls, games). Use only for maintenance.
set_log_chat_note: The audit log seals' hashes are posted there, so a change to the database can be noticed from outside it.
log_chat_prompt: 📮 Add Aegis to a channel as an admin who can post, then forward a post from it here (or send its @username or -100… id).
log_chat_bad: ⚠️ Forward a post from the channel, or send its @username or -100… id.
log_chat_probe: 📮 Aegis: this channel now receives the audit log seals.
version_data: Data migrations: {data} of {latest} · command menus rev. {cmd}
version_platform: Runs on Telegram Serverless (tgcloud): no server of its own and no paid service.
problem_webhook: • The webhook is not set (npx tgcloud webhook sync).
problem_backlog: • Many updates are waiting in the webhook queue.
problem_delivery: • Telegram reported a delivery error in the last hour.
problem_errors: • Ten or more errors in the last hour.
problem_stuck: • Some updates were left half done (they are retried).
problem_join: • Aegis is not admin in a forced-join channel.
problem_late: • Some timed items are late (see Queues).
problem_guard: • The audit log's database guard is off.
health_join: 🔒 Forced join: {state} · channels: {n} · bot not admin: {bad}
health_note: Checked {at} UTC. There is no scheduler on this platform: timed work runs on the side of updates, so it can be late while nobody uses the bot.
jobs_off: ⏸ Timed work: paused — broadcasts and sweeps wait.
q_posts: 📝 Channel posts: {pending} waiting for approval · {scheduled} scheduled
queues_note: Late items are handled with the next updates.
sweep_started: 🧹 The sweeps run right after this press; refresh in a moment.
backups_explain: • Global file: system settings, forced-join channels and the bot team. • Chats: the configuration of every chat Aegis is in ({chats} now), {per} chats per file ({parts} file(s)) — settings, lists, locks and security, the same as each chat's own backup. Punishments and logs are records, not configuration, and are not included. Restore takes one of these files: values are checked again; channels and team members are added, nothing is removed; chats are restored only where Aegis is now.
backup_globals_caption: 💾 Aegis global backup: settings, {join} forced-join channel(s), {staff} team member(s).
restore_prompt: ♻️ Send the backup file (.json) made here.
restore_need_file: ♻️ Send the backup as a file, or cancel.
restore_download_failed: ⚠️ The file could not be downloaded: {error}
restore_err_too_big: ⚠️ The file is too big (over 1 MB).
restore_err_not_backup: ⚠️ This is not an Aegis global backup.
restore_err_version: ⚠️ This backup is from another format version.
restore_err_empty: ⚠️ There is nothing to restore in this file.
restore_q_globals: ♻️ Restore the global settings? Settings: {settings} · forced-join channels: {join} · team members: {staff}. Channels and members missing now are added; nothing is removed.
restore_q_chats: ♻️ Restore the configuration of {chats} chat(s)? Only chats Aegis is in now are restored; each chat's current values are replaced by the file's.
restore_expired: ⌛️ That file was checked over 30 minutes ago; send it again.
restored_globals: ✅ Restored: {settings} setting(s), {join} channel(s) added, {staff} team member(s).
restored_chats: ♻️ Restored {applied} chat(s) ({values} values); skipped {skipped} (Aegis is not there or the backup does not fit).
restore_more: Done {done} of {total}. Press continue for the next chats.
health_webhook_managed: 🔗 Webhook: managed by Telegram Serverless (npx tgcloud webhook shows it and repairs drift).
